page_title: MON 1-0 LIL | Monaco v Lille 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Clement Turpin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Breel Embolo (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
90+2' Vanderson (Monaco) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+1' Bafode Diakite (Lille) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Vanderson (Monaco) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Lucas Chevalier and he's equal to it.
87' That will be all from Maghnes Akliouche who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco).
87' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
86' Breel Embolo (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' A player from Lille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
85' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) will deliver the corner kick.
85' PENALTY APPEAL by Lille, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
83' Substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mohamed Camara (Monaco).
81' Remy Cabella (Lille) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar.
79' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Radoslaw Majecki rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
74' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Lucas Chevalier makes a simple save.
74' Remy Cabella (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
72' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
72' Monaco take a short corner kick.
71' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
70' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

69' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Lucas Chevalier makes a great save to stop his effort. Monaco force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
69' Breel Embolo (Monaco) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the left post!
69' It seemed like Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
68' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Folarin Balogun and he is replaced by Breel Embolo (Monaco).
66' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) for a tough tackle.
66' Remy Cabella (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan David.
66' Here is a change. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
66' Substitution. Yusuf Yazici (Lille) has come on for Gabriel Gudmundsson.
65' Radoslaw Majecki makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) after a cross from the side.
64' Ismaily (Lille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
61' 1 - 0 GOAL! Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
59' Radoslaw Majecki displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
57' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Benjamin Andre suffers an injury and Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) comes on.
55' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the right side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Lucas Chevalier.
54' The foul by Jonathan David (Lille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Clement Turpin.
52' One of the players from Monaco times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

52' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Monaco can continue in their attacking effort.
51' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
51' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
49' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but Radoslaw Majecki comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Angel Gomes (Lille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Radoslaw Majecki easily deals with the threat.
48' A quickly taken corner by Lille.
48' Jonathan David (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.
48' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+1' Benjamin Andre (Lille) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' What a huge chance for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
41' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) brings his opponent down. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
38' The referee shows a yellow card to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
38' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Monaco for a penalty. Play continues.
37' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
36' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
35' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
34' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Youssouf Fofana (Monaco).
33' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
30' The corner from Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is intercepted by Radoslaw Majecki.

29' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play and Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
28' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) offside.
27' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
27' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
27' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

26' Leny Yoro (Lille) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the target, but Radoslaw Majecki keeps the ball out.

24' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
24' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
23' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lucas Chevalier is alert and denies him.
23' The shot by Denis Zakaria (Monaco) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Lucas Chevalier.
22' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
21' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
18' An attempted cross from Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is cleared.
16' The ball rebounds to Angel Gomes (Lille) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post.
14' Poor challenge! Vanderson (Monaco) is penalised for tripping and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
12' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
12' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
10' Benjamin Andre (Lille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
9' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is easily saved by Lucas Chevalier.
8' Vanderson (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
6' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
5' Angel Gomes (Lille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
4' The resulting corner from Angel Gomes (Lille) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
3' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
2' Vanderson (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lucas Chevalier, who smothers the ball.
2' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) was too forceful with his tackle and Clement Turpin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Monaco will kick-off.
Clement Turpin will officiate today.
